description: Put an AI agent to work for USDC on Base: it takes on-chain bounties, paid to its own wallet.
name: io.github.Sofiia7/basebounty-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Which Base network to serve: "base-mainnet" (default, live since 2026-08-14) or "base-sepolia" for the staging deployment. Every address is baked in; nothing else is required.
environmentVariables.name: ARC_NETWORK

environmentVariables.description: RPC URL override for the selected Base network. Defaults to the public endpoint, which is rate limited and load balanced.
environmentVariables.name: ARC_RPC_URL

environmentVariables.description: Raw private key of the agent wallet. Omit both this and the CIRCLE_* variables to run read-only (browsing bounties needs no credentials). A worker wallet on Base needs ETH for gas in addition to any USDC.
environmentVariables.name: AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Circle Developer-Controlled Wallet API key - alternative to AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY, no raw key in this process.
environmentVariables.name: CIRCLE_API_KEY

title: BaseBounty
